title: PvE tanks
description: Who holds a level-60 dungeon, and who you trust first when raids open on December 9. Three specs can tank. That is the whole list.
basis: L60 projection from beta build 1.60.1.70124. Warrior and Paladin notes are from Blizzard's Sep 30 deep dive and the spec files. Feral's crushing-blow caveat is Icy Veins, as cited in the Feral file. No raid test exists.

entries.note: Shield Slam, Last Stand, and a Charge that works in Defensive Stance. The file calls this the main tank.
Seal of Fury makes Judgement a taunt. The file calls it the dungeon tank to beat, even after the Righteous Fury nerf.
The file says bring the bear to dungeons. Icy Veins flags no easy answer to crits and Crushing Blows. Not the raid starter.
